verdict.rationale: Smart Capture Link is explicitly documented as a 'low- to no-code frontend solution' that lets teams verify individuals 'with or without engineering effort,' directly matching the no-ticket, ops-led send-a-link use case. However, the evidence never explicitly confirms QR-code generation or shows the ops-facing dashboard workflow for creating/sending such links, and most other docs (SDK tokens, API workflow) describe the developer-integration path rather than the no-code path. Missing for 10: explicit QR-code capability, ops-console screenshots/workflow for generating and sending links, and independent/hands-on confirmation of the no-code experience.
